### AMediaCodec_createInputSurface

Declared in `media/NdkMediaCodec.h`
    
    media_status_t AMediaCodec_createInputSurface(
      AMediaCodec *mData,
      ANativeWindow **surface
    )

Creates a Surface that can be used as the input to encoder, in place of input buffers. This can only be called after the codec has been configured via AMediaCodec_configure(..); and before AMediaCodec_start() has been called. The application is responsible for releasing the surface by calling ANativeWindow_release() when done. For more details, see the Java documentation for MediaCodec.createInputSurface. Available since API level 26.

L2850: 
L2851: Instantiate the preferred decoder supporting input data of the given mime type. The following is a partial list of defined mime types and their semantics:
L2852:   * "video/x-vnd.on2.vp8" - VP8 video (i.e. video in .webm)
L2853:   * "video/x-vnd.on2.vp9" - VP9 video (i.e. video in .webm)
L2854:   * "video/avc" - H.264/AVC video
L2855:   * "video/hevc" - H.265/HEVC video
L2856:   * "video/mp4v-es" - MPEG4 video
L2857:   * "video/3gpp" - H.263 video
L2858:   * "audio/3gpp" - AMR narrowband audio
L2859:   * "audio/amr-wb" - AMR wideband audio
L2860:   * "audio/mpeg" - MPEG1/2 audio layer III
L2861:   * "audio/mp4a-latm" - AAC audio (note, this is raw AAC packets, not packaged in LATM!)
L2862:   * "audio/vorbis" - vorbis audio
L2863:   * "audio/g711-alaw" - G.711 alaw audio
L2864:   * "audio/g711-mlaw" - G.711 ulaw audio
L2865: Note: It is preferred to use `【114†MediaCodecList.findDecoderForFormat】` and `【115†createByCodecName(String)】` to ensure that the resulting codec can handle a given format.
